name: braid
description: Wallet linkage analysis for EVM and Solana. Paste public addresses, get the evidence that ties them together.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @braid/core && npm run build --workspace @braid/api && npm run build --workspace @braid/cli && npm run build --workspace @braid/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @braid/api" "npm run dev --workspace @braid/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core apps/api apps/cli && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
